integrity: The reported theorem is supported by an analytic argument and a standalone checker. Its correctness, originality and value have been assessed within the inspected evidence only; independent verification is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the real predator-free invariant axis and its normal linearization are treated. The invariant interval includes negative prey coordinates and exceeds carrying capacity; no positive-population or nonlinear invasion inference. General mortality central limit laws, outside-axis persistence and exceptional seeds are excluded.
title: A flat normal Lyapunov spectrum with Gaussian fluctuations on a cubic predator-free boundary
